name: t0/greedy
why: GGUF build, run because the MLX engine has open non-termination bugs for this model family: lmstudio-ai/mlx-engine#337 (Gemma 4 fills max_tokens with reasoning and returns empty content, 'GGUF terminates fine'), lmstudio-ai/lmstudio-bug-tracker#1018 (reasoning never ends in qwen3 thinking models on MLX), #1907 and jundot/omlx#934 (qwen3.6-27b and qwen3.6-35b-a3b infinite loops). Greedy on BOTH arms, so the comparison is reasoning alone -- which the MLX runs could not offer, being confounded either by hot resamples or by a non-greedy thinking profile. GGUF also honours --context-length, which MLX ignores (lmstudio-bug-tracker#2250), so the window is a control here rather than an observed variable. NOT a clean engine A/B against the MLX numbers: quantisation differs between the builds. Greedy is tried first for a single-variable arm. Community reports say GLM loops at the vendor-recommended t1.0 and behaves better at 0.2-0.7, and that MLX is more stable than GGUF for this model -- the opposite of the other entries here -- so this one is the least certain of the set. The runtime ceiling bounds the downside.
